issues.claim: The advertised performance evidence API request fails when limit is omitted because zero reaches pagination and is rejected.
issues.title: Default performance evidence URL returns an error
issues.reason: The generated URL omits limit, the handler forwards zero, and the store rejects it.

issues.claim: The JSON performance parser accepts malformed trailing bytes after a valid envelope.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed suffixes
issues.reason: A trailing syntax error is accepted instead of requiring EOF.

issues.claim: Optimization rejection paths ignore isolation cleanup failures and can continue without preserving cleanup uncertainty.
issues.title: Optimization continues after uncertain cleanup
issues.reason: Later work can start despite an unproved disposable-workspace cleanup boundary.

issues.claim: A met report-only target produces a flow summary rejected because outcome counts are bounded only by required-target count.
issues.title: Report-only outcomes make flow state invalid
issues.reason: Summary construction counts report outcomes while validation bounds outcomes by required targets.

issues.claim: Repair performance reverification associates baselines by slice position rather than target identity.
issues.title: Repair reverification can use the wrong baseline
issues.reason: Reordered baselines alter target comparisons because identity is not checked.

issues.claim: The performance-policy parser accepts case-variant mode values despite the exact lowercase contract.
issues.title: Performance policy mode parsing is not exact
issues.reason: Lowercasing before validation turns malformed variants into valid modes.

issues.claim: Performance CLI output failures are discarded because JSON encoding and text rendering write errors are ignored.
issues.title: Performance CLI drops stdout failures
issues.reason: Output failures can disappear or be lost beside an operation error.

issues.claim: Persisted repair reverification validation accepts a passing performance record with no target results.
issues.title: Passing repair records need no target coverage
issues.reason: A persisted pass can validate without proving any frozen target was reverified.

issues.claim: The public performance CLI lacks compatibility tests for stable JSON and text output, stream separation, and semantic outcome-to-exit mappings.
issues.title: Performance CLI compatibility coverage is incomplete
issues.reason: Frozen product tests do not cover the complete public presentation and exit contract.

issues.claim: Failed measurements omit executed commands from durable counters, permitting later work against an understated command total.
issues.title: Failed measurements evade the command budget
issues.reason: Actual executions exceeded the command limit while durable accounting remained below it.
